notes.title: Trade(PVP)
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
Today I want to tell you about the Online Trade system.

By entering the Trade (PVP) app on your tablet, you can select 10 cars from your collection and play a luck-based trading game either with your friends or with random players from all around the world.

The game consists of 10 rounds. In each round, you pick a random car from your opponent’s collection, and your opponent picks a random car from yours. The player who puts the more valuable car on the table wins both cars for that round!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/4351df9b3aa33322d39f621e8169948cffa7e8e9.png[/img]

The main goal here is to hunt your opponent’s cheaper cars with your expensive ones, while trying to match your low-value cars against their most valuable ones.

I can't wait to see what kind of trades you’ll make and what you’ll win!

Best wishes.

notes.title: Collectors #1 - Car Love from a Collector
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings, collectors! [/b][/h1]

[i][b]You know why you're here, right?[/b][/i] There's only one reason: you want to build your dream supercar collection and take it to the top. I've seen my fair share of obstacles over the years as an old collector, but each one taught me what true collecting is all about…

In these posts, I'll share with you how to do more than just collect cars. You'll learn how to make them valuable, uncover their histories, and build your collection with the right strategies.
But remember, no matter how much theory you learn, nothing beats the hands-on experience. 

[b]Download Supercar Collection Simulator Demo, get behind the wheel, and then come back here. Let’s hit the road together! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453690/Supercar_Collection_Simulator_Demo/

[b]Is everyone ready? Let’s get started… Oh, and don’t forget to wishlist Supercar Collection Simulator right now, so you’ll be all set to build your ultimate garage and take on the world of racing and collecting as soon as it’s out! 
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453600/Supercar_Collection_Simulator/

Let’s look our key points:

[h3][b]Displaying Your Collection[/b][/h3]
What’s the most important part of any toy car collection? Yes! THE CARS, of course! If you want to impress other collectors, you need to display your collection properly. You can’t just toss them in a drawer and expect people to appreciate them. It’s not a cluttered shelf; it’s a carefully curated exhibit. Use display cases, stands, and custom shelves to show off your most prized pieces. The better you display them, the more attention they’ll get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/09b0f6f1ef68eaea57f5cd6e5a27150afdeb298f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Building Your Reputation[/b][/h3]
You can own all the supercars in the world, but if no one knows about your collection, what’s the point? Building a solid reputation is crucial. Organise races, show off your best cars, and let other collectors be in network. Your name will be on the tip of everyone's tongue, and soon enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/229d8110aadc27de19c563a6bdbda19188e64a38.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The Thrill of the Mystery Box[/b][/h3]
There’s nothing quite like the excitement of cracking open a new card pack. You never know what you’re going to get, will it be that rare, limited-edition car you’ve been eyeing, or will it be another duplicate? That’s the magic of it all. Each pack is a mystery waiting to be unraveled, and every pull could bring a new addition to your collection. You’ve got to take the gamble. After all, the best pieces don’t just appear; they’re uncovered in these mystery boxes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/65250f66261d24bd3cd20a973a6e616fb6a00e25.gif[/img]

[i]That about wraps up today’s lesson![/i]

[b]Catch you in the next post, where we’ll dive even deeper into the world of toy car collecting!
If you want to connect with other passionate collectors, why not join our Discord server? You can chat about cars, collections, and all things toy cars with fellow car lovers.[/b]
